headline: Order momentum translating into growth

highlights: INR 148bn in FY26), positioning the company well to achieve its FY27 guidance of INR 250bn.
A robust external bid pipeline of INR 1.3trn, complemented by opportunities from group entities, provides strong order visibility.
The strong OI secured over the past few quarters are now translating into execution, with Q2 revenue growing 26% YoY to INR 27.5bn (flat QoQ).
EBITDA margin improved 40bps YoY to 9.7%, while PAT grew 22% YoY to INR 1.3bn.
